<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\nGarage estimate documents are automatically placed in the wrong category, forcing manual correction. This leads to missed evidence and delays because critical information is overlooked during claims processing.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Five accounts have reported this issue, representing a total ARR of £4,290,000 [i:0b669b812359487f][i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:6401b85f53f8e56b][i:6f60a28973334f3b].\n- The problem has been raised by customers across three routes: support, account management, and onboarding [i:0b669b812359487f][i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:6401b85f53f8e56b].\n- One account, Marrowgate Commercial, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12 [i:6401b85f53f8e56b][i:766f9ca2be319649].\n\n## Evidence\n- There have been 13 mentions of this problem from the five accounts [i:0b669b812359487f][i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:6401b85f53f8e56b].\n- Eight mentions came via the support route [i:0b669b812359487f][i:27425ffc5bea7e8a][i:35bc60912c19d67e][i:5109cfcbf29475a5][i:6f60a28973334f3b][i:71622a189d0b930d][i:8621fe0ded65ffe4][i:a3f2a53f98cd8130].\n- Two mentions came via the account management route [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:1d02c338591f1b06].\n- Three mentions came via the onboarding route [i:6401b85f53f8e56b][i:766f9ca2be319649][i:a918397cecacd89d].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty, with an ARR of £740,000, has stated that garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it [i:0b669b812359487f]. They also report that handlers are spending too much time fixing the incorrect file type assignments, which impacts claim accuracy [i:35bc60912c19d67e][i:71622a189d0b930d].\n- Linnet House Insurance, with an ARR of £360,000, reports that every time a garage estimate gets dumped into correspondence, someone has to manually fix it — and sometimes the wrong document category means evidence gets overlooked entirely [i:0fc6cb6155656fe2]. They have reiterated this issue via support, stating it risks missing critical evidence [i:27425ffc5bea7e8a][i:5109cfcbf29475a5].\n- Thistlecombe Mutual, with an ARR of £980,000, has mentioned the document upload system keeps assigning the wrong category — say, putting repair quotes under correspondence — which leads to incorrect file type issues [i:1d02c338591f1b06].\n- Marrowgate Commercial, with an ARR of £1,600,000, reported during onboarding that when we upload garage estimates, they land under Correspondence — that incorrect file type is causing handlers to manually re-categorise everything [i:6401b85f53f8e56b]. They later noted this manual work risks things slipping through the cracks and causes delays in handling claims properly [i:766f9ca2be319649][i:a918397cecacd89d].\n- Brackwater Homecover, with an ARR of £610,000, states that every time we upload a garage estimate, it lands in correspondence — it’s a wrong document category and handlers keep missing key evidence because of it, which delays claims resolution [i:a3f2a53f98cd8130].\n\n## Why now\n- One renewal has occurred in the last 90 days [i:0b669b812359487f][i:0fc6cb6155656fe2][i:6401b85f53f8e56b].\n- The most recent mentions from customers occurred in October 2026, indicating the problem is current and actively causing operational pain [i:0b669b812359487f][i:27425ffc5bea7e8a][i:6f60a28973334f3b][i:a3f2a53f98cd8130].\n- Marrowgate Commercial, a key account with an ARR of £1,600,000, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12, and they have recently highlighted this issue as causing delays [i:6401b85f53f8e56b][i:a918397cecacd89d].",

<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the ARR totals, mention counts, routes, renewal dates, and quoted passages against the cited insights and fact sheet. The five accounts sum to £4,290,000 matching the fact sheet; per-account ARRs (Saltmarsh £740,000, Linnet House £360,000, Thistlecombe £980,000, Marrowgate £1,600,000, Brackwater £610,000) are all correct; the 13 mentions split 8/2/3 across support, account management, and onboarding matches both the fact sheet and the route citations on each bullet; Marrowgate's renewal date of 2026-12-12 and the one renewal in the last 90 days are correct; and the October 2026 mention dates are supported by the cited insight timestamps. Quoted phrases match the insight quotes verbatim, and the Thistlecombe paraphrase accurately reflects its 'repair quotes under correspondence' quote. No uncited claims, overstated scope, or contrary evidence found.", "verdict": "pass"}
